description: Trigger evals for screen-spec-fleet: it fires when six or more Figma frames each need their own spec doc and foundations plus SCREEN_MAP already exist, while screen-spec, design-bootstrap, image-to-spec, journey-map and verify-against-rubric-fleet handle a single screen, a missing design system, image-only sources, a flow across screens, and checking finished specs against a rubric.

should_trigger: I have 14 onboarding and settings frames in Figma, foundations are done and SCREEN_MAP.md exists. Here is the list with number, slug, persona and node id for each. Spec them all in parallel.
spec out all nine checkout screens at once, figma mcp is connected and I pasted the node ids below
Foundations docs are in place and SCREEN_MAP.md lists the 14 screens of the driver app. Split the work so every frame gets its own spec file and routes.md gets rebuilt at the end.
we need SCREEN_SPECs for the whole billing section, 7 frames, node ids in the table below, do them in one go instead of one by one
Batch job: 16 marketing-site frames from the Figma file, all for the first-time visitor persona, each with its slug already assigned. Generate all the screen docs and merge the map.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Document the login screen from this Figma frame, node 41:812. Just that one, I need layout, components and error states.
There are 10 frames to document but we have no foundations folder, no tokens extracted and no SCREEN_MAP yet. Where do I even start with the Figma file?
All 12 screen specs for the driver app are written. Check each one against our locked spec-quality rubric in parallel and tell me which criteria fail most often.
I only have five PNG mockups from the designer, nothing in Figma. Turn them into structured specs.
Map the path from cart to order confirmation across the 4 screens we already documented, with critical states and the components each step uses.
